string.GitlabDesc: Connect your GitLab projects to sync issues, merge requests, and project updates
string.NotAuthorized: Authorize {title} to access your GitLab account. Projects where you have the Maintainer role will be listed here.
string.NoRepositories: No projects with the Maintainer role were found for this account.
string.AutoClose: This tab will close in {time} seconds
string.KeepSettingsOpen: Keep the {title} settings tab open while connecting GitLab, then try again
string.SetupWhere: Choose where to register the application in GitLab:
string.SetupGroupOwned: Group-owned (recommended for teams): in the group's Settings > Applications
string.SetupInstanceWide: Instance-wide (self-managed administrators): in the Admin area
string.SetupTrustedHint: Tick Trusted to skip the consent screen for users.
string.SetupConfidentialScopes: Tick Confidential, select the scopes {scopes}, then save the application.
string.SetupCopyCredentials: Copy the Application ID and Secret below. GitLab shows the secret only once.
string.KeepSecretHint: Leave empty to keep the current secret
string.OwnerMustConfigure: A workspace owner needs to set up the GitLab application first.
string.InvalidGitlabUrl: Enter an https:// URL (http:// only for localhost or *.local hosts)
string.SetupEnterUrlFirst: Enter the URL of your GitLab instance below to see where to register the application.
string.DisconnectEveryoneConfirm: Disconnect every member's GitLab account from this workspace? Their linked projects are unlinked and webhooks are removed where possible. Members can connect again afterwards.
string.IssueConnectedActivityInfo: Connected to GitLab issue #{number} in {repoName}
